FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Everard stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle shift is underway. The king, resplendent in his ornate armor, strides through the courtyard, his gaze fixed on the horizon.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Everard sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. The air is thick with the scent of old parchment and burning incense. The king's eyes gleam with an otherworldly intensity as he speaks.

KING EVERARD
(leaning forward)
My friends, the time has come to revolutionize our aesthetic. We shall shed the drabness of our forebears and forge a new path, one that blends the grandeur of our empire with the... (pauses, searching for the right words)...the mystique of the unknown.

ADVISOR 1
(nervously)
Your Majesty, are you certain this is wise? Our people are accustomed to the traditional ways.

KING EVERARD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Foolishness! We shall incorporate the eerie glow of luminescent mushrooms, the iridescent sheen of butterfly wings, and the haunting melodies of the theremin into our art. We shall create a world that is at once familiar and yet, utterly alien.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The king's vision begins to take shape. The castle walls are now adorned with glowing, ethereal murals, depicting scenes of medieval battles and mythological creatures. The sound of distant, wavering synths drifts through the air, accompanied by the soft rustle of silk and the distant hum of machinery.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors gather around a large, ornate mirror. They gaze upon their reflections, now distorted by the warped, VHS-style distortion of the mirror's surface.

ADVISOR 2
(awed)
By the saints... what sorcery is this?

KING EVERARD
(smiling)
It is the essence of our new aesthetic, my friends. We shall call it... (pauses, a mischievous glint in his eye)...Everardian Vapowave.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The once-staid streets are now filled with the sounds of distorted, 8-bit video games and the sight of people dressed in attire that blends medieval finery with futuristic, neon-lit accents.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. The air is thick with the scent of incense and the distant hum of machinery. The king's eyes gleam with an otherworldly intensity as he speaks.

KING EVERARD
(leaning forward)
My friends, our empire shall be reborn. We shall be the masters of a new world, one that is at once familiar and yet, utterly alien.

FADE TO BLACK.
